name: experiment
description: Agentic access to the sollertia-experiment and sollertia-micro-controllers libraries: the system-agnostic core for acquisition system design, hardware interfaces, runtime patterns, external data-service processors, hardware discovery and system health checks, the host-side Unity VR task driver, end-to-end build and operation pipelines, and session lifecycle management on the experiment host. Owns the extension path of both libraries, the configuration registry and shared cross_system primitives a new acquisition system composes, the MCP tool-module and CLI group registration seams, and the firmware module, controller target, and board family seams. System-specific skills live in dedicated companion plugins (e.g. the 'mesoscope' plugin for the Mesoscope-VR reference system). Backed by the single sollertia-experiment MCP server (sle mcp), which registers the hardware-agnostic tool module alongside the active system's own, covering both the `sle get` and `sle mesoscope` surfaces. The MCP tool roster does not mirror the CLI command roster, and the session-acquisition runtimes stay CLI-only. Its hardware-discovery and health-check skills additionally require the assets plugin's sollertia-shared-assets MCP server (slsa mcp) and the ataraxis marketplace's ataraxis-video-system (axvs mcp) and ataraxis-communication-interface (axci mcp) servers.
